7// DTOs are untrusted proposals until schema + semantic validation succeeds.
8// Value wrappers prevent accidental mixing, not forged IDs or default values.
9public readonly record struct TenantId(string Value);
10public readonly record struct EntityId(string Value);
11public readonly record struct RelationshipId(string Value);
12public readonly record struct ProjectionId(string Value);
13public readonly record struct GraphId(string Value);
14public readonly record struct InputId(string Value);
15public readonly record struct TypeId(string Value);
16public readonly record struct PropertyId(string Value);
17public readonly record struct OperatorId(string Value);
18public readonly record struct DocumentId(string Value);
19public readonly record struct BlockId(string Value);
20public readonly record struct Revision(string Value);
21public readonly record struct RequestId(string Value);
22public readonly record struct ContentHash(string Value);
23public readonly record struct IdentityDomain(string Value);
24public sealed record OntologyRef(string Id, string Version, ContentHash Digest);
25public sealed record GraphVersion(TenantId Tenant, GraphId Graph, Revision Revision);
26public sealed record Diagnostic(string Code, string Path, string Message);

30[JsonPolymorphic(TypeDiscriminatorPropertyName = "kind")]
31[JsonDerivedType(typeof(TextValue), "text")]

58public sealed record EntityState(EntityId Id, TypeId Type, ImmutableArray<PropertyValue> Properties);

61 TypeId Type, ImmutableArray<PropertyValue> Properties);
62public sealed record GraphExtent(ImmutableArray<EntityState> Entities,
63 ImmutableArray<RelationshipState> Relationships);
64public sealed record SnapshotBinding(string Port, GraphVersion Snapshot);
65public sealed record VirtualRegion(string Id, ContentHash ProviderDigest, string ProviderVersion,
66 string Definition, ImmutableArray<SnapshotBinding> Inputs);
67public sealed record GraphDescriptor(GraphVersion Version, ProjectionId Projection,
68 OntologyRef Ontology, ImmutableArray<VirtualRegion> VirtualRegions);
69// A page is not a graph snapshot by itself; seal binds all pages and virtual regions.
70public sealed record SnapshotPage(string SnapshotToken, long Page, GraphExtent Extent);
71public sealed record SnapshotSeal(string SnapshotToken, GraphDescriptor Descriptor,
72 long PageCount, ContentHash Digest);
